checkpoints: 章节标题是否与模板一致（如 "Performance Evaluation"）

## 7 Accuracy Evaluation

This section describes the accuracy evaluation results for the Qwen3-235B-A22B
model on vLLM-Ascend platform.

| Benchmark | vLLM-Ascend | vLLM (H100) | Delta  |
|-----------|-------------|-------------|--------|
| MMLU      | 86.2        | 86.5        | -0.3%  |
| GSM8K     | 91.3        | 91.5        | -0.2%  |

## Performance Test

This section evaluates the inference performance of Qwen3-235B-A22B.

| Input Length | Batch Size | Throughput (tokens/s) | Latency P50 (ms) |
|-------------|-----------|----------------------|-------------------|
| 512         | 1         | 1250                 | 45.2              |
| 1024        | 4         | 4800                 | 88.6              |
| 2048        | 8         | 9200                 | 178.3             |
